rationale: diagnose_fix of job 20261106T201841Z-53a7a2 on top of repo_pipeline_qwen3/0cf48efadbe1ae86 (all of its D1-D9 changes kept). D16: Qwen3-8B layer 16 down_proj input has content-triggered token outliers (token "2") that the prefix cannot absorb, so the O2 per-tensor static A4 scale collapsed (block 16 MSE-init loss 9.5, block loss ~30). The wrapper switches to PrefixQuant-O1 (paper Table 1; README: add --activation_clipping for dynamic): --input_mode dynamic --kv_mode dynamic --kv_group_size 128 --activation_clipping, keeping prefix tokens, rotations, mse_init and block-AP (epochs default 20, PREFIXQUANT_EPOCHS override, 0 = mse_init only). Repo fixes needed for O1: block_mse_init_dynamic kept the bound_factor shape ([1]; the original assigned a 0-dim linspace element, which save_pretrained wrote as a scalar that a fresh quantizer cannot load); dynamic_fake_quant restores the input shape after group-wise quantization (the original check never fired). prefix_runtime/adapter rebuild the saved mode from prefixequant_config.json (dynamic per-token A4 and group-wise KV4, learned clipping factors loaded and checked; K quantizer is unclipped as in the repo), reshape legacy 0-dim factors, report mode/clipping in quant_agent_runtime, and keep the fresh prefix-KV injection for forward and generate.
